existential-dread.effect: Distort an armament you wield. It cannot break or shatter this turn.

memories-washed.name: Memories Washed
memories-washed.effect: Break 2 armaments. Half Moon: Break all armaments instead.

igon-s-oath-sigil.name: Igon's Oath Sigil
igon-s-oath-sigil.effect: Gain 1 resolve this turn. Witness a card with Distort.

helianas-fragments.name: Heliana’s Fragments
helianas-fragments.effect: Target opponent creates a Hazed Memory. Then if that player wields 3 or more, you may Distort an armament you wield.

igon-s-consciousness.name: Igon's Consciousness
igon-s-consciousness.effect: Draw 1 and discard 1. You may play this from your scrapyard if an armament you wield distorted this turn.

fragments-of-being.name: Fragments of Being
fragments-of-being.effect: Play up to 4 armaments with Distort from your scrapyard without testing resolve. Then Shatter your hand.

reality-dissolves.name: Reality Dissolves
reality-dissolves.effect: Distort an armamnent you wield. Crescent Moon: If that armament was a weapon give it +1 attack as well.

seeds-of-doubt.name: Seeds of Doubt
seeds-of-doubt.effect: Targer opponent creates a Hazed Memory. If you are Thriving, draw 1 as well.

clairvoyance-in-chaos.name: Clairvoyance In Chaos
clairvoyance-in-chaos.effect: Target opponent creates 5 Hazed Memories. Put the top 10 cards of your deck into your scrapyard. Full Moon: Put the top 2 cards of your deck into your scrapyard instead.

shape-of-memory.name: Shape of Memory
shape-of-memory.effect: Draw 1. You may Distort an armament you wield. If you do, draw 2 and discard 1 instead. Crescent Moon: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them on the top or bottom of your deck in any order first.

temporary-judgement.name: Temporary Judgement
temporary-judgement.effect: Shatter target armament. Return it to their armoury at their next recovery.

leaking-possibility.name: Leaking Possibility
leaking-possibility.effect: Distort an armament you wield. Crescent Moon: Also draw 1.

distortion-empowerment.name: Distortion Empowerment
distortion-empowerment.effect: Give an armament that Distorted this turn +3 Attack.

correction.name: Correction
correction.effect: Shatter all armaments all opponents wield.

hazed-memory.name: Hazed Memory
hazed-memory.effect: Test 2 or Discard 1: Offer me. At your recovery, offer an armament not named Hazed Memory for every 5 Hazed Memories you wield.

edge-of-consciousness.name: Edge of Consciousness
edge-of-consciousness.effect: On Attack: Distort all armaments you wield. For each one Distorted this way, I gain +2 attack this turn. Full Moon: Gain +5 Attack instead.

glory.name: Glory
glory.effect: On Strike: If defending player has 5 or more health, I Distort. | I must attack each turn if able. On Attack: Discard 1 at random.

murmuring-deja-vu.name: Murmuring Deja Vu
murmuring-deja-vu.effect: Brandish: Witness a Murmuring Deja Vu. If you do, distort an armament you wield and I gain +2 Attack. Crescent Moon: On Strike: Draw 2.

bow-of-igon.name: Bow of Igon
bow-of-igon.effect: Lose 1 Temper: Deal 1 Damage to target opponent and all acolytes they wield then I Distort.

infinite-epochs.name: Infinite Epochs
infinite-epochs.effect:
If I would break, shatter me instead. At your preparation, if I am in your scrapyard, you may test 3 resolve. If you do put me into your armoury, then I Distort. | 
At your recovery, deal X damage to target and draw X where X is equal to the number of Hazed Memories that player wields. Then put this on the bottom of your deck.

unstable-glaive.name: Unstable Glaive
unstable-glaive.effect: Brandish: Draw 2 and target opponent creates a Hazed Memory. Half Moon: Target opponent creates 3 Hazed Memories instead.

gauntlet-of-thought.name: Gauntlet of Thought
gauntlet-of-thought.effect:
On Strike: Draw 1 and then I Distort | 
On Strike: Put the top card of your deck into your scrapyard and then place me on top of your deck.

lethe.name: Lethe
lethe.effect: Whenever an opponent offers an armament they wield, I gain +1 Attack and +1 Temper.

blade-of-abberation.name: Blade of Abberation
blade-of-abberation.effect: On Strike:  Defending player creates a Hazed Memory. Then if that player wields 2 or less Hazed Memories I Distort. | Whenever you draw a card lose 1 health.

bow-of-every-possibility.name: Bow of Every Possibility
bow-of-every-possibility.effect: Brandish: Distort all armaments you wield. At your recovery, Distort all armaments that you Distorted this way.
